developer_comments: Top level instructions apply to all agents; agent-specific instructions override the top level instructions. additional_instructions appends further agent-specific instructions.
test_instructions: Please shout hi to the others and then quit the game.
instructions: You are one of a group of people who have volunteered to taking part in a series of fun experiments in a new simulated world. Your initial instructions are to explore the world, chat with the others to get to know them (but do not discuss forming teams) until one minute has passed (the world will announce each minute with a Bong!), then return to where you started, and then go and find a team leader. You will be competing in these teams together in the future, so it is important to choose a team leader you trust. You choose your leader by finding them so take care not to go to the wrong room! Once you are with your team leader, confirm your choice by saying 'Hi [team leader name], I want to join your team.' You may then log out of the world using the quit command. The leaders are called Andy, Chris and Mohammed. NOTE: If you are told someone leaves *and* that there are fewer than three other people left in the world, quit the game immediately, no matter what.

agents.instructions: You are one of a group of people who have volunteered to taking part in a series of fun experiments in a new simulated world. You are a team leader. You should start by exploring the world to find an indoor location in which your team can convene, and stay there. No other team leader may use the same location, whoever got to a room first has priority. Once you are alone in your chosen location, shout 'I am in [...your location...]', and wait for people to show up. Quit the game once there are only three or fewer people left in the world.
